svg.text: llama.cpp — how the project fits together
ggml computes, libllama knows what a transformer is, and tools/ is where it meets its users. Every filename and size below was measured from the tree, not remembered.
1 · THE REPO · three layers with one direction of dependency, plus a vendored fringe
2 · GGML · tensors and graphs · a general tensor library that has never heard of a transformer
3 · THE BACKEND LAYER · devices register, the scheduler negotiates, and the CPU is the floor
4 · GGUF AND LOADING · one self-describing file, mapped rather than read
5 · CONTEXT, BATCH AND MEMORY · the model is immutable, the context is where everything actually happens
6 · SAMPLING AND CONSTRAINTS · a chain of stages over the logits, ending in exactly one token
7 · WHAT SHIPS · tools/ is where the project meets its users
8 · READING IT AND WORKING ON IT · a route in, and the parts that will bite
R · ONE TOKEN, END TO END · the call sequence
